use bitflags::bitflags;

bitflags! {
    #[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
    pub struct Permissions: u32 {
        const READ = 1;
        const WRITE = 2;
        const EXECUTE = 4;
    }
}

impl core::fmt::Display for Permissions {
    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut core::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> core::fmt::Result {
        bitflags::parser::to_writer(self, f)
    }
}

fn main() {
    for bits in 0..16 {
        let flags = Permissions::from_bits_retain(bits);
        let mut edited = flags;
        edited.insert(Permissions::READ);
        edited.toggle(Permissions::WRITE);
        edited.remove(Permissions::EXECUTE);
        println!("{} {} {} {} {}", bits, flags.contains(Permissions::READ),
            flags.intersects(Permissions::WRITE | Permissions::EXECUTE),
            edited.bits(), (!flags).bits());
        let text = format!("{}", flags);
        let parsed = bitflags::parser::from_str::<Permissions>(&text).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(parsed, flags);
        println!("{} {:?}", text, flags);
        let collected: Permissions = flags.iter().collect();
        assert_eq!(collected, flags);
    }
    assert!(Permissions::from_bits(8).is_none());
    assert_eq!(Permissions::from_bits_truncate(15).bits(), 7);
    assert!(bitflags::parser::from_str::<Permissions>("MISSING").is_err());
    let flags = Permissions::READ | Permissions::WRITE;
    assert_eq!((flags & Permissions::WRITE).bits(), 2);
    assert_eq!((flags - Permissions::READ).bits(), 2);
    assert_eq!((flags ^ Permissions::READ).bits(), 2);
    println!("registry bitflags complete");
}
